rv.q: Still, it’s tough to resist the rainbow bear hug of From Here and hope for its evolution and future.
Yet we’ve invested so much time in Daniel’s personal saga that the Pulse story feels, unfortunately, tacked on.
From Here has a perfectly fine message—community is important and mass shootings are tragic—but fails to makes its points in a new or vital way.
Unfortunately, it’s about as cringe as one might expect.
From Here excels in its sincerity and emotional resonance.
Overall, the show is moving and touching, especially enhanced by the cast all being from Orlando.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this Pulse nightclub shooting musical, with some praising its heartfelt celebration of queer resilience and community, while others criticize its focus on white narratives and question whether the tragedy suits musical theater treatment.
